simple.summary: שָׁרוּחֶן (Shârûwchen) means Sharuchen , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 6.

definitions.full: H8287. Sharuchen שָׁרוּחֶ֑ן proper name, of a location in Simeon ; — Josh 19:6 ( ᵐ5 οἱ ἀγροὶ αὐτῶν , ? reading שְׂדֵיהֶן ); WMM As.u.Eur.161, 168 identified with Egyptian Ša-r(a)-µa-na .
